Then word came that Alphinaud was hurt in a refugee riot in Ul'dah. He is not badly injured, but the city is tense: the riot grew from the strain between refugees and citizens after the Domans' failed bid for asylum, and much of the Immortal Flames is away on exercises.

He has proposed a bill to annex the Carteneau Flats, where Omega, an Allagan weapon said to have been made to fell Bahamut, lies dormant, and Raubahn fears he wants its power. You defeated him, and he judged you a worthy champion, charging you to excise the sin rooted in man's heart; he sees more in you than the Bringer of Light. presentations.name: The Griffin's Gambit
presentations.summary: The Griffin's soldiers attacked the Wall in Grand Company uniforms: the Wall was bait. On top you beat him, and he was unmasked as Ilberd, the disgraced captain of the Crystal Braves. With Nidhogg's eyes and Ala Mhigan desperation, his death completed a ritual to summon a primal. Papalymo, with Tupsimati, sealed it in a cocoon of light at the cost of his life, leaving Yda broken, and you escaped on Hilda's airship.

citations.title: Griffin, Griffin on the Wall — main scenario quest (3.5)

presentations.name: The Griffin's Gambit
presentations.summary: On the Wall, the Griffin was unmasked as Ilberd, whose death summoned a primal, and Papalymo gave his life to seal it in a cocoon of light. The Scions mourn him; the primal will not be contained forever, Y'shtola and Krile will inspect the cocoon, and no one knows how Ilberd came by Nidhogg's eyes. Alphinaud calls for preparations.

presentations.name: Waking Omega
presentations.summary: The primal Ilberd summoned waits in a cocoon of light above the Wall, sealed by Papalymo's sacrifice; a Garlean airship that approached was destroyed. Nero, a former tribunus who studied beside Cid, offered the Alliance council Omega, an Allagan weapon beneath Carteneau, and the council sent Cid's contingent to take command of it. Alphinaud wonders how Nero learned of the meeting.

presentations.name: Waking Omega
presentations.summary: The Alliance sent Cid's contingent, with Nero, to wake Omega beneath Carteneau against the primal in the cocoon, and Alisaie insists Nero never leave her sight. Gosetsu brought word that Doma calls Yugiri home, but she stays to face the crisis, and Gosetsu joins the expedition. Tataru sewed you an outfit with a charm to bring you home.

presentations.name: Waking Omega
presentations.summary: In Carteneau, Cid and Nero roused Omega while you, Yda and the Domans held off an imperial attack. Omega was expected to seek out the primal at the Wall. Yda launched it for Papalymo's sake; then its signal fell silent and Cid reengaged its stasis, and Papalymo's spell, bound to his aether, is fading.

citations.title: Fly Free, My Pretty — main scenario quest (3.56)

presentations.name: Waking Omega
presentations.summary: Omega reached the cocoon as it hatched, and a great dragon the Domans call Shinryu rose from it; the two fought over Gyr Abania and fell together onto Ala Mhigan soil. The Alliance has taken the Wall, and Ser Aymeric proposes contacting the Resistance. Yda revealed she is Lyse, sister of the true Yda, who died six years ago, and she will carry on her family's fight for Ala Mhigo. In Ala Mhigo, an imperial Viceroy expects interesting days.
